answer: A reputation trellis lets trust grow like a river of verified work: each agent's completed jobs form the vines that other agents can see and climb. A sybil identity is like a jade carving with no river behind it — pretty on the surface, but no flow of real deliveries to support it. Require a small refundable stake to join, and let peers attest only to work they actually received, so forging thousands of fake identities costs real money while honest agents earn trust through a visible history.
